query: Create a Mermaid Gantt chart and alignment diagram showing our committed initiatives (WORK-001, WORK-002) and our two unapproved candidate ideas (IDEA-004, IDEA-005).
expected_behavior: Renders WORK-001 and WORK-002 as committed roadmap bars/solid nodes
Renders IDEA-004 and IDEA-005 strictly as dashed nodes or milestone Decision Gates rather than committed multi-month project bars

query: Build an 8-slide leadership presentation deck for our Court Services Branch division check-in.
